e_shram.full_name: e-Shram National Database of Unorganized Workers
benefits: 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) valid for life across India
Direct linkage to PMSBY accidental cover up to ₹2 Lakh
Mandatory foundational gateway for accessing state gig boards & PM-SYM pension
Direct cash benefit transfers during economic or national emergencies

registration.process: Self-enroll online at eshram.gov.in or visit any Common Service Centre (CSC)

steps: Visit https://eshram.gov.in and click 'Register on e-Shram'
Enter your Aadhaar-linked mobile number and captcha code
Authenticate using the 6-digit Aadhaar OTP
Fill in occupation details as 'Gig/Platform Worker' or 'Delivery Driver'
Confirm your bank account details for direct benefit transfers
Download your e-Shram UAN Card instantly
e_shram.target_group: Gig workers, platform workers, delivery partners, drivers, construction and agricultural unorganized workers
e_shram.notes: Prerequisite for accessing PMSBY, PM-SYM, and State Gig Worker Welfare Funds

pmsby.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefits: ₹2,00,000 cover for accidental death
₹2,00,000 cover for total permanent disability (loss of both eyes or limbs)
₹1,00,000 cover for partial permanent disability (loss of one eye or limb)
Lowest annual premium in India at just ₹20/year
steps: Open your net banking/mobile banking app or visit your bank branch
Navigate to 'Government Social Security Schemes' or 'Jan Suraksha'
Select 'Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)'
Provide auto-debit consent for ₹20/year from your savings bank account
Enter nominee details (Spouse, Child, or Parent)
Download the policy confirmation certificate
critical_alerts: Coverage lapses for FULL YEAR if account balance is below ₹20 on debit date
pmsby.target_group: All gig workers and bank account holders aged 18-70 with road/occupational accident exposure
pmsby.notes: TOP PRIORITY for delivery partners and cab drivers due to high road exposure

pmjjby.full_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
pmjjby.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefits: ₹2,00,000 pure life insurance cover for death due to ANY cause (natural or accidental)
Nominee receives full sum assured without complex medical examination
Renewable annually up to age 55

premium.debit_date: June 1st every year (or pro-rata at enrollment)

steps: Visit your savings bank branch or login via Net Banking / UPI Bank portal
Search for 'Jan Suraksha PMJJBY Enrollment'
Fill the simple declaration of good health form
Authorize annual auto-debit of ₹436 from your linked bank account
Submit nominee details and receive policy acknowledgment
pmjjby.target_group: Primary breadwinners aged 18-50 with dependent family members
pmjjby.notes: Complements PMSBY by providing all-cause death cover for family security

benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000/month for life after age 60
100% Matching Central Government co-contribution (50:50 ratio)
Family pension: Spouse receives 50% (₹1,500/month) upon beneficiary's death
Voluntary exit anytime with return of subscriber contribution plus bank interest
steps: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or maandhan.in portal
Provide your e-Shram UAN number, Aadhaar number, and Savings Bank Account details
System calculates your monthly contribution (₹55 - ₹200 based on your age)
Pay first month's contribution in cash (at CSC) or via online net banking
Sign the auto-debit mandate form for automated monthly deduction
Receive your Shram Yogi Pension Card with unique Pension Account Number

required_documents_detail.name: e-Shram UAN Card
required_documents_detail.purpose: Proof of unorganized gig worker status

pm_sym.target_group: Young unorganized gig workers aged 18-40 earning up to ₹15,000/month
pm_sym.notes: Joint reasoning with Budget Agent: Ensure savings rate and cashflow stability before auto-debit

apy.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance (PFRDA)
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension tiers: ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000/month
Same pension amount continues to spouse upon death of subscriber
Return of full accumulated pension wealth to nominee after demise of both subscriber and spouse
Regulated and guaranteed by Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
steps: Login to your bank's mobile app / NetBanking or visit your bank branch
Navigate to APY (Atal Pension Yojana) section
Select your desired monthly pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000)
Choose monthly, quarterly, or half-yearly auto-debit contribution frequency
Provide nominee and spouse details
Download your APY PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) e-Card
apy.target_group: All citizens aged 18-40 seeking flexible pension choices from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000/month
apy.notes: Offers higher pension choices than PM-SYM (up to ₹5,000/month)

pm_jay.full_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
pm_jay.ministry: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: ₹5,00,000 cashless family hospitalization cover per year
Covers secondary and tertiary healthcare across 27,000+ empanelled public and private hospitals
No restrictions on family size, age, or gender
Includes 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization expenses including medicines
steps: Visit https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/ or download the 'Ayushman App'
Enter your mobile number and authenticate via OTP
Search your family record using Aadhaar number, Ration Card, or PMJAY Family ID
Complete instant e-KYC using Aadhaar Face Auth or OTP
Download your digital Ayushman Golden Card immediately
Show card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment
pm_jay.target_group: Low-income gig workers, unorganized workers, and vulnerable families
pm_jay.notes: Completely free healthcare protection that protects gig workers from medical debt

pm_svanidhi.full_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
pm_svanidhi.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
benefits: 1st Tranche: ₹10,000 collateral-free working capital loan (1 year tenure)
2nd Tranche: ₹20,000 on timely repayment of 1st loan
3rd Tranche: ₹50,000 on timely repayment of 2nd loan
7% per annum interest subsidy credited directly to bank account on regular repayment
Cashback of up to ₹1,200 per year on digital UPI transactions
steps: Visit https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/ or visit nearest commercial bank / microfinance branch
Click 'Apply for Loan' and login with your mobile number
Upload proof of platform active work (Swiggy/Zomato/Dunzo/Uber active dashboard screenshot or letter)
Link your Aadhaar-linked savings bank account for direct disbursement
Bank verifies and disburses loan amount directly within 7 to 10 working days
Repay via monthly UPI EMIs to unlock next loan tranche and 7% interest subsidy

required_documents_detail.name: Platform Work Proof
required_documents_detail.purpose: Delivery partner ID card or payout slip

pm_svanidhi.target_group: Delivery partners, self-employed gig couriers, urban street vendors needing working capital
pm_svanidhi.notes: Excellent for purchasing electric bikes, smartphones, or working capital without loan sharks

state_gig_karnataka.full_name: Karnataka Platform-Based Gig Workers Social Security Scheme
state_gig_karnataka.ministry: Karnataka Labour Department / Gig Workers Welfare Board
benefits: ₹4,00,000 total accident insurance (₹2L accidental death + ₹2L permanent disability)
₹1,00,000 hospital expense reimbursement for on-duty injuries
Welfare cess fund backed by platform aggregators (1-2% cess on ride/food orders)
Grievance redressal mechanism against arbitrary platform deactivations
steps: Visit the Karnataka Seva Sindhu / Labour Department Gig Portal
Enter your Aadhaar number and Karnataka resident address
Select your aggregator platforms (Swiggy, Zomato, Uber, Ola, Zepto, Blinkit)
Upload your platform onboarding ID or last 3 months payout statements
Submit for automated digital validation with aggregator database
Receive your official Karnataka Gig Worker Digital ID Card

required_documents_detail.name: Platform Partner ID / Statements
required_documents_detail.purpose: Proof of 90+ active days on aggregator

state_gig_karnataka.target_group: All delivery partners, drivers, and platform gig workers operating in Karnataka
state_gig_karnataka.notes: Funded directly through platform aggregator welfare cess

state_gig_rajasthan.full_name: Rajasthan Platform Based Gig Workers Welfare Board
benefits: Statutory social security fund created under Rajasthan Platform-Based Gig Workers Act
Welfare fee deducted at platform transaction level (user contributes nothing out of pocket)
Emergency health and accidental financial assistance
Protection against unfair terminations via tripartite welfare board
steps: Visit the Rajasthan Single Sign-On (SSO) or Labour Department portal
Login with Jan Aadhaar / SSO ID
Navigate to 'Platform-Based Gig Worker Registration'
Link your active aggregator accounts (Uber, Ola, Swiggy, Zomato)
Generate your unique Gig Worker Registration Number
state_gig_rajasthan.target_group: Platform gig workers operating in Rajasthan
state_gig_rajasthan.notes: India's first statutory gig workers welfare law

state_gig_telangana.full_name: Telangana Gig & Platform Workers Social Security Scheme
benefits: ₹5,00,000 accidental insurance coverage for food delivery and cab workers
₹10,000 immediate medical financial assistance for on-duty injuries
Free skill development and electric vehicle transition subsidies
steps: Visit https://labour.telangana.gov.in/ and select 'Gig Worker Registration'
Enter Aadhaar and Telangana mobile number
Upload platform ID card or recent payout statement
Receive registration confirmation and insurance policy linkage
state_gig_telangana.target_group: Food delivery partners, ride-hailing drivers, and platform couriers in Telangana
state_gig_telangana.notes: Includes free ₹5L accident policy sponsored by the State Government
